title: When the mind is anxious under pressure
issueStatement: The mind keeps rehearsing danger before the future has even arrived. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru widens attention from imagined danger back toward Hukam, remembrance, and the care already present. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future.
actionPrompt: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
